svg.title: Kepler Dev — Folded planes monogram
svg.desc: Horizontal wordmark. Mark: two angled material planes (primary currentColor, secondary mineral) meeting at a vertical seam, with a calm pearl aperture and a single bronze hairline along the top edge of the right plane. Text: KEPLER DEV in tracked uppercase system sans, currentColor.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
